preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A student's desk seen from slightly above at a three-quarter angle on a pale warm off-white surface, a collage of study tasks: a stack of three closed textbooks with plain cloth covers in muted ink blue, pale ochre and warm grey, an open lined exercise book with a dark blue fountain pen lying across it, a small plain grey calculator with unmarked blank keys and a wooden ruler, a pair of plain over-ear headphones resting on a thick closed dictionary-like book, one blank printed answer sheet with rows of small empty squares and no letters, a few blank pale sticky notes and a wooden pencil. The whole group fills the right half of the frame and stays below the top edge; the left half of the frame is the empty smooth warm off-white desk surface for text. Soft daylight from the upper left, one soft contact shadow. Everything blank: no handwriting, no letters, no numbers, no text, no logos, no brand marks, no screens, no hands, no people.
